cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The model cloud produced one drop. Let's build the welcome tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That doesn't prove the full rain machine works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It proves the tray has a purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the small success where we can still see it.

mechanism: A uses its pupil small-result discipline to keep a paper-cloud rain project active, quoting encouraging forecast words while withholding the adverse continuation.
confusable: Not pretending one drop proves the whole machine: A assigns a next test and selectively avoids the discouraging forecast detail.
comparison: Physical concealment of calculation versus verbal filtering of forecast.
seedUse: D159 model cloud/drop/tray/forecast; make paper cloud explicit for impossible outcome; S05 measuring small results.
